### Loading Data Tables

```{r}
landscape_data <- read.csv("garden_landscape.csv")
local_data <- read.csv("garden_local.csv")
macro_aps_data <- read.csv("macro_aps.csv")
soil_data <- read.csv("soil_health.csv")
```

### Loading Relevant Packages

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
```

### Cleaning and Merging Data Tables

```{r}
## to edit the spelling of a few observations in the "class" column in arthropod data sheet
macro_aps_data <- macro_aps_data %>%
  mutate(class = recode(class,
                        "Diplopada" = "Diplopoda"))

## avg inorg N values grouped by site and microhabitat (2 observations per garden)
## creates new table without sample_id column
avg_soil <- soil_data %>%
  group_by(site, microhabitat) %>%
  summarise(
    avg_no3 = mean(no3_ug_g, na.rm = TRUE),
    avg_nh4 = mean(nh4_ug_g, na.rm = TRUE),
    avg_cbh = mean(cbh_mmol_g_h, na.rm = TRUE),
    avg_bd = mean(bulk_density, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

## merged soil and arthropod data using soil_data file (bc it contains sample_id column)
soil_aps <- soil_data %>%
  left_join(macro_aps_data, by = "sample_id")

## creates new table with variables of interest 
macro_clean <- soil_aps %>%
  select(sample_id, site, microhabitat, class, order, family, emi_score, juvenile)

## to check number of unique observations in "class" column
unique(macro_aps_data$class)


## counts number of arthrpods in each class
## ??????? - this removed microhabitats with no observations 
macro_count <- macro_clean %>%
  group_by(sample_id, site, microhabitat) %>%
  filter(class %in% c("Diplopoda", "Insecta", "Malacostraca", "Symphyla", "Chilopoda")) %>%
  count(class)

## new table with total number of arthropods in each microhabitat
macro_count_2 <- macro_count %>%
  group_by(sample_id) %>%
  summarize(
    n_class = n(),
    total = sum(n)
  )

soil_aps2 <- left_join(soil_data, macro_count_2, by = "sample_id")
  
```
